root_cause: The Android 'Build x64' job's CMake configure step fetches the sentencepiece v0.2.1 source tarball directly from a GitHub release asset URL (github.com/google/sentencepiece/releases/download/v0.2.1/sentencepiece-0.2.1.tar.gz) via FetchContent during OpenVINO Tokenizers configuration. GitHub returned an HTTP 504 (gateway timeout) for this request, which is a transient upstream availability issue on GitHub's release-asset CDN, not related to the PR under test (Update Protobuf to 6.31.1) which does not touch sentencepiece or tokenizers build logic. This exact failure signature (sentencepiece-0.2.1.tar.gz HTTP 504) has been seen once before on 2026-10-01, plus a related HTTP 500 variant of the same download, confirming recurring flakiness of this external GitHub release-asset fetch.
reproduction_steps: Re-run the 'Build x64' job of the Android workflow; the failure is intermittent and tied to GitHub release-asset availability, not deterministically reproducible locally. To reproduce manually: configure OpenVINO with -DENABLE_OV_TOKENIZERS=ON (or an equivalent flag enabling GenAI/Tokenizers FetchContent) on an Android/riscv-cross toolchain and observe the CMake FetchContent step attempting to download https://github.com/google/sentencepiece/releases/download/v0.2.1/sentencepiece-0.2.1.tar.gz; a transient 504/500 from GitHub will reproduce the same CMake 'Each download failed!' error.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Build x64' job (automated remediation requested via remediate_transient_failure) since this is a transient network failure.
Consider mirroring the sentencepiece release tarball in an OpenVINO-controlled or more reliable CDN/cache to reduce dependency on GitHub release-asset availability for this recurring flaky download.

Consider adding a retry/backoff wrapper around the FetchContent download step for third-party release tarballs (sentencepiece in particular) to self-heal transient 5xx errors without requiring a full job rerun.

The 'Each download failed!' search string is already present in .github/scripts/workflow_rerun/errors_to_look_for.json (category Network), so the automated workflow rerunner should already catch and retry this class of failure on monitored pipelines.
prevention_strategies: Mirror or cache third-party release tarballs fetched via CMake FetchContent (sentencepiece, and similar GenAI/Tokenizers third-party deps) inside OpenVINO's own artifact storage to avoid depending on GitHub's release-asset CDN reliability. Ensure the CMake download step uses a retry count/backoff (e.g., multiple URLs or a local mirror fallback) rather than a single-shot download that fails the whole build on any transient 5xx.
historical_context: Two prior occurrences of the same sentencepiece-0.2.1.tar.gz download failure are recorded: an HTTP 500 variant on 2026-10-01 (PR #36733, pattern ab13d93818e84607) and an HTTP 504 variant on 2026-10-01 (PR #38536, pattern 8c8192df2f508443, now updated to count=2 by this run). This confirms the GitHub release-asset download for sentencepiece is a recurring source of transient merge-queue failures unrelated to PR content.
